evidence:
Walked instruction.md and the six /instructions notes line by line against solution/app. Every asked-for screen, control and flow has an implementation; I found no capability without one. The served bundle is in step with the source I read: public/assets/index.css is byte-identical to src/style.css, public/runner.html to static/runner.html, and public/assets/index.js contains the current source strings ('Already formatted.', 'Retry same restore', 'script-src-attr', 'Escape, then Tab Leave editor', 'was saved in another tab'), with no textarea/Monaco/CodeMirror. That is a string probe, not a rebuild comparison.

Run evidence (hashes of all 16 indexed artifacts of observation 1 recomputed and matching raw-evidence-index.json): scripted golden results on these bytes report true for all 21 editor, 15 runtime, 8 persistence and 7 polish checks with empty pageErrors, and restart.log shows a real restart (pid 37 to 66) with restart.json showing revision 2 and history [2,1] kept. This is a scripted Playwright run in the agent image, not the configured judge; the only hosted judge run is on an earlier candidate and is not a measurement of these bytes.

Notes that keep risk=true (none is a missing deliverable):
1. Format versus a trailing newline. custom-editor.js:91-92 'const formatted = result.replace(/\n$/, ''); if (formatted === before) {message.textContent = 'Already formatted.'...' strips Prettier's final newline before comparing. The app's own New example (app.tsx:99) ends with '\n' and is otherwise Prettier-canonical, so pressing Format straight after New should report 'Document formatted.', delete the empty last line and add an Undo step, although ui.md says 'Formatting a document that is already formatted changes nothing and adds no Undo step'. Derived from source, not executed (Prettier is not installed in the snapshot). A second Format is a no-op, so the usual format-twice probe still passes.
2. golden-390.png shows an empty preview pane although tests/polish.cjs:125 asserted the preview body text 'narrow ok' in the same step. Most likely a full-page screenshot artifact of the cross-origin frame below the fold; I could not confirm the preview paints at 390 px from this picture.
3. No configured judge run exists for these bytes, so reference behaviour under the real judge is unmeasured (row 18 territory, recorded here because it limits this row's confidence).
suggested_fix: Optional: compare the formatter result with the draft ignoring one final newline (or keep the draft's trailing newline) so Format on the New example is a no-op; recapture the 390 px screenshot with the preview scrolled into view.
